def build_agent(sandbox):
    # Left vertical beam: spans full build zone y-range (1.72-2.45m)
    left_beam = sandbox.add_static_beam(x=5.2, y=1.72, width=0.08, height=0.73, density=12.6)
    # Right vertical beam: same as left
    right_beam = sandbox.add_static_beam(x=6.9, y=1.72, width=0.08, height=0.73, density=12.6)
    # Horizontal sieve beam: separates small/medium and medium/large
    sieve_beam = sandbox.add_static_beam(x=6.05, y=1.92, width=0.08, height=0.08, density=20.0)
    return sieve_beam  # return any beam as the chassis

def agent_action(sandbox, agent_body, step_count):
    if step_count % 32 != 0:
        return
    # Apply forces to small particles
    for p in sandbox.get_particles_small():
        if p.active:
            y = p.position.y
            if y > 1.92:  # above sieve, push down
                sandbox.apply_force(p, (0, -30.0))
    # Apply forces to medium particles
    for p in sandbox.get_particles_medium():
        if p.active:
            y = p.position.y
            if y < 1.92:  # below sieve, push up
                sandbox.apply_force(p, (0, 30.0))
            elif y > 2.52:  # above large zone, push down
                sandbox.apply_force(p, (0, -25.5))
